speed.notes: 50 feet, fly 200 feet; climb stone 50 feet,;

traits.name: Slow Aura
traits.text: (arcane, aura, enchantment); 10 feet. Each creature that ends its turn in the aura must succeed at a DC 37 Will saving throw or be slowed 1 for 1 round (or slowed 2 on a critical failure). The copper dragon can turn this aura on or off with a single action, which has the concentrate trait, and can choose not to affect allies within the aura.

traits.name: Twisting Tail
traits.text: ⬲ Trigger A creature within reach of the copper dragon's tail uses a move action or leaves a square during a move action it's using. Effect The dragon makes a tail Strike at the creature with a –2 penalty. If it hits, the dragon disrupts the triggering action.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.text:
⬺ The copper dragon breathes in one of two ways. The dragon can't use Breath Weapon again for 1d4 (1d4) rounds.
  • Acid (acid, arcane, evocation); The dragon breathes acid in a 100-foot line that deals 18d6 (18d6) acid damage (DC 38 basic Fortitude save).
  • Slowing Gas (arcane, transmutation); The dragon breathes a 100-foot line of slowing gas. Each creature in the area must succeed at a DC 38 Fortitude save or be slowed 1 for 1 round (or slowed 2 on a critical failure).

traits.name: Climb Stone
traits.text: The dragon's climb speed functions only when climbing stone surfaces.

traits.name: Draconic Frenzy
traits.text: ⬺ The dragon makes two claw Strikes and one tail Strike in any order.

traits.name: Draconic Momentum
traits.text: When the dragon scores a critical hit with a Strike, it recharges Breath Weapon.

traits.name: Mass Laughter
traits.text: ⬺ (arcane, emotion, enchantment, mental); Frequency once per day Effect The copper dragon tells a fantastic joke. Each creature in a 100-foot emanation must succeed at a DC 39 Will save or suffer the effects of a 9th-level hideous laughter spell for 1 minute.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ jaws +33 (acid, magical, reach 15 feet); Damage 3d10+16 (3d10+16) piercing plus 3d8 (3d8) acid

actions.text: ⬻ claw +33 (agile, magical, reach 10 feet); Damage 3d10+16 (3d10+16) slashing
